name: Avaati Vya
description: The inventor who developed a process to refine volatile raw aether.

description_citations.text: "Consulate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avaati Vya cracks the aether code, developing a refinement process that separates aether's energy-rich part from its volatile part.
timeline.quote: Six decades ago, the world-renowned aetherologist Avaati Vya cracked the aether code.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: The Great Aether Boom begins as the Mending leaves massive quantities of raw aether available.
timeline.quote: Since the powers of the Planeswalkers were reduced, there were suddenly massive quantities of raw aether for the taking.

citation.text: "Avishkar", section "Great Aether Boom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Avaati Vya refines raw aether, the Consulate distributes it, leading to an inventors' renaissance.
timeline.quote: Their efforts led to a plane-wide inventors' renaissance

citation.text: "Consulate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A world-renowned aetherologist who cracked the aether code six decades ago by developing the refinement process.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

pages_say.description: An inventor whose prototype aether refiner is at the Museum of Invention.

citation.text: "Revolution Begins" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jan 2017.
